classification.difficultyReason: Construct a frequency polygon, calculate summary statistics from frequencies and combine graphical and numerical evidence to justify an approximately normal shape.

inlines.text: The number of tomatoes on each plant of a large sample of a particular species of tomato is shown in the table.
Number of tomatoes on a plant

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw a frequency polygon of the data.

spec.description: Blank plotting scaffold with horizontal grey gridlines every 20 plants, no vertical gridlines or arrowheads, and labelled values 6 to 14.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal grid step 20 in frequency units; x labels at integer tomato counts 6 through 14; frequencies 0 through 180.
spec.answerVisibility: No data points or joining segments appear in the question.

answer.worked: Plot each tomato count against its frequency and join consecutive points with straight segments.

spec.description: Complete frequency polygon on the supplied scaffold.
spec.mathematics: Nine frequency points joined in increasing tomato-count order.
spec.answerVisibility: Complete plotted answer appears only in answer editions.

children.label: b
children.prompt:
Calculate the mean, mode, median of the data. Give the mean to 2 decimal places.

Reminder: you will need to make the $xf$ and $cf$ columns on the table.

answer.short:
Mean: $9.99$ tomatoes per plant; mode: $10$ tomatoes; median: $10$ tomatoes.

Use $\bar{x}=\frac{\sum xf}{\sum f}$; locate the middle observations using $cf$, and find the tomato count with greatest frequency.

inlines.latex: \begin{aligned}\sum f&=700\\\sum xf&=6994\\\bar{x}&=\frac{\sum xf}{\sum f}\\\bar{x}&=\frac{6994}{700}=\frac{3497}{350}\\\bar{x}&\approx9.99\text{ tomatoes per plant}\end{aligned}

inlines.text: The highest frequency is 160, for 10 tomatoes, so the mode is 10 tomatoes.

There are 700 plants. The median is the average of the 350th and 351st values. The cumulative frequency increases from 270 at 9 tomatoes to 430 at 10 tomatoes, so both middle values are 10. The median is 10 tomatoes.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Justify whether this is approximately a normal distribution.

answer.short: Yes. The distribution is approximately symmetric and bell-shaped, and the mean, median and mode are all approximately 10.
answer.worked: The frequency polygon has one central peak near 10, with frequencies decreasing on both sides in an approximately symmetric, bell-shaped pattern. The mean is approximately 9.99 and the median and mode are both 10. These features support an approximately normal distribution.
